profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I am a software engineer with 10 years of professional experience building and maintaining software. I am a lifelong learner, I enjoy embracing new challenges, and staying adaptable to changing environments. I love creating secure, efficient and logical software for clients that goes beyond just meeting their needs.

UX/UI | Debugging | Flexibility/Adaptability | Attention to Detail | Team Collaboration | Communication | Thinking As an End User

BS in Applied Computer Science, Northern Arizona University

positions.title: Front End Software Engineer
positions.description:
Designing, developing, and maintaining user interfaces for web application with Angular
and Typescript, ensuring a seamless and visually appealing user experience
Collaborating closely with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality, scalable, and
performant web applications, ensuring an exceptional user experience
Working closely with backend developers to integrate front-end components with back-end
services in an Agile Scrum team, participating in code reviews and writing unit tests

positions.title: Full Stack Software Engineer
positions.description:
Full-stack development with Ruby on Rails and Microsoft SQL Server, primary developer role as client’s main point of contact for planning and development. User authentication, data visualization, generating productivity reports, and more.
Client-facing engineering role, extracting and implementing software requirements building a document-tracking web software application that handles several thousand documents per month to facilitate hospital operations

positions.title: Ruby on Rails Software Engineer
positions.description: Volunteer position with professors from the Computer Science department. Assisted in the implementation of a Ruby on Rails calendar trips organizing-application for the National Parks Service. Also gained experience with Angular JS, Heroku and PosgreSQL throughout project development building an interactive monthly calendar that met specific requirements from the client. Primarily worked server-side, building a complex database and relationships with Active Record. I also used various Rails gems and CSS frameworks building a user-friendly front end.

positions.title: PHP Software Developer Intern
positions.description: Full-time Internship - Built a PHP + Zend Framework 2 application operating with Google Cloud Storage to start/stop pre-configured instances with no prior exposure to these. Also fully implemented user authentication with OAuth. Primarily worked solo under the oversight of two senior software developers. The application was built to eventually be used to automatically start and stop servers in use by clients based on peak traffic times.
